summary.description: Dioxins and furans are chlorine-containing crystalline solids that dissolve in oils, fats, and organic solvents but not readily in water. They are persistent environmental pollutants with many chemical variants.
emission_sources: Natural sources such as forest fires and volcanoes
environmental_impact: May cause cancer and affect the heart, liver, immune system, skin, thyroid, and unborn children
Deposited on soil and water where they accumulate in livestock, wildlife, and fish
Persistent in environment and bioaccumulate through food chains

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Dioxins and furans pose serious health risks including cancer, immune and hormonal disruption, and harm to unborn children, impacting human well-being.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: These compounds accumulate in aquatic sediments and bioaccumulate in fish, threatening marine ecosystems and biodiversity.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: The pollutant originates mainly from combustion and industrial processes, highlighting the need for sustainable production and waste management practices.
